Restrictions apply. See terms at http://sportsbook.fanduel.com.The No. 3 Michigan Wolverines (35-3) and the No. 2 Arizona Wildcats (36-2) meet Saturday in an NCAA Tournament National Semifinal game. Tip-off from the Final Four at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana, is scheduled for 8:49 p.m. ET (TBS / truTV / HBO Max). Let's analyze NCAA basketball odds around the Michigan vs. Arizona odds and make our expert college basketball picks and predictions for the best bets.Michigan has made 9 appearances in the Final Four, although 2 of those appearances have been vacated. It won its only national championship in 1989 in Seattle, topping Seton Hall behind Glen Rice and Rumeal Robinson.Arizona is in the Final Four for the fifth time in school history, and it has 1 national title back in 1997, under the tutelage of the late, great coach Lute Olson.This is the first meeting between these schools since Nov. 21, 2021, with Arizona winning 80-62 as a 3.5-point underdog as the Under (146.5) cashing at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. The Wildcats have won and covered each of the previous 3 meetings since Dec. 14, 2013, while the Over has hit in 2 of those 3 encounters.Michigan crushed Tennessee 95-62 in the Elite 8, easily covering as an 8.5-point favorite as the Over (146.5) cashed. F Yaxel Lendeborg went for 27 points, 7 rebounds, 4 assists, 2 blocks and a trio of 3-pointers, while G Elliot Cadeau posted 8 points, 10 assists and a block.The Wolverines have won all 4 of their NCAA Tournament games by at least 13 points, with an average margin of victory of 22.5 points per game (PPG). Michigan has covered the past 3 games and the Over is 4-1 in the past 5 outings.Arizona pushed past Purdue in the Elite 8, winning 79-64 as a 5.5-point favorite as the Under (152.5) cashed. F Koa Peat racked up 20 points with 7 rebounds and 3 assists. The Wildcats have each of their 4 NCAA Tournament games by at least 12 points, with the margin of victory of 20.5 PPG.
